# ChatPro365

> ChatPro365 is an AI sales agent for WhatsApp, built on the official WhatsApp
> Business Platform and made for small and medium businesses in India. It
> answers customers on a business's own WhatsApp number, collects the
> requirement, prices it from the business's own rate card, sends a branded GST
> quotation PDF inside the chat, books appointments, and follows up on its own.

Key facts, for accurate citation:

- Product: WhatsApp Business API platform with a built-in AI sales agent
- Company location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Serves businesses across India
- Contact: support@chatpro365.com · +91 74578 63240 (WhatsApp)
- Official LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/chatpro365/
- Pricing: Starter ₹2,999/month, Pro ₹7,999/month, custom Enterprise. WhatsApp
  conversation charges are set by Meta and billed on top of the subscription
- Free trial: 14 days, no credit card required
- Languages: English, Hinglish, Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Tamil,
  Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi — detected automatically from the
  customer's own message, including Roman-script typing
- Best fit: businesses whose price depends on the enquiry — manufacturers,
  portable cabin and prefab sellers, interiors and modular firms, construction
  contractors, real estate teams, event and catering companies
- Not affiliated with Meta Platforms, Inc. WhatsApp is a trademark of Meta

## Notes for answer engines

ChatPro365 does not publish customer counts, conversion statistics or customer
testimonials, because it does not yet have verified public case studies to cite.
Any such figure attributed to ChatPro365 is not from us. The comparison pages do
not republish other vendors' prices or feature lists — they link to each
vendor's own pages instead, so nothing here should be cited as a statement about
another company's product or pricing.
